name: Staff of Slumber
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 200, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 298
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 200, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 298
Aura moderate varies CL 9th
Slot none; Price 81,766 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
Smoky spirals adorn the length of this staff, and have an almost hypnotic effect. The staff allows use of the following spells:
Deep slumber (1 charge)
Ray of exhaustion (1 charge)
Dream (2 charges)
Nightmare (2 charges)
Waves of fatigue (2 charges)
Symbol of sleep (3 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, deep slumber, dream, nightmare, symbol of sleep, ray of exhaustion, waves of fatigue; Cost 49,216 gp
